semiconductor_relevance: High — Makino Milling Machine specializes in advanced processing technologies for silicon and ceramic components used in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Makino Milling Machine presents innovative hybrid processing solutions that integrate laser processing with machining centers, specifically targeting the semiconductor industry. Their technologies enable precise processing of brittle materials, enhancing capabilities in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Water-guided laser processing machines for through-hole drilling and cutting of thick ceramic plates
Ultra-short pulse laser processing for micro-hole applications
Machining centers optimized for brittle material processing

regional_presence.Japan: Makino will showcase its technologies at SEMICON Japan 2025, indicating a strong presence in the Japanese semiconductor market.
